description: Fitness (CTL, 42-day), Fatigue (ATL, 7-day) and Form (TSB = CTL - ATL) day by day up to `date`, computed from each workout's TSS (0 when Suunto has none) with the standard exponential model, as in generate_daily_digest (Suunto's API has no such endpoint). CTL can be about 1 point off the watch. Without seeds the 120 days before the window warm it up; with little history CTL reads low (4-6 weeks to converge), which notes says. Result: current, weeks, series (end-of-day; tss 0 = rest day), notes. Touches no digest files.

date.description: Last day of the series, YYYY-MM-DD.

seedCtl.description: Optional: CTL at the end of the day before the series starts, read off the watch or app; skips the warm-up (a missing seed starts at 0).

name: get_training_load
title: Get training load (CTL/ATL/TSB)
